notes.title: Virtualcast ver 2.7.3a released
notes.content:
[h2]Virtual Cast App[/h2]
[h3]System Update[/h3]
[list]
[*]The base system for Virtual Cast, Unity, has been updated to Unity 6.
[/list]
[h3]Spec Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]The preset characters "Repair" and "Sienta" have been added. The default character has also been changed from "The Boy" to "Repair." "The Boy" is still available as a preset character.
[*]In rooms, the deployment of new VCI items is now temporarily paused while a location loads. VCI items will now appear after the location display effect is complete.
[/list]
[h3]Functional Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved the operational stability of rooms where multiple VCI cameras for taking photos are placed.
[/list]
[h2]Wan-Kome Integration[/h2]
[list]
[*]Wan-Kome OSC Plugin ver 1.2.1 has been released.
[*]Fixed an issue where special characters such as '<', '>', and '&' were not being correctly replaced when receiving comments containing multiple such characters.
[list]
[*]The folder structure of the plugin has been changed. When updating, please replace the entire folder instead of overwriting its contents.
[/list]
[*]For more information on installing the plugin, please see [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/deliverytool/onecomme]here[/url].
[*]The [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/deliverytool/onecomme/plugin]plugin download link[/url].
[/list]

tags.feature: The preset characters "Repair" and "Sienta" have been added. The default character has also been changed from "The Boy" to "Repair." "The Boy" is still available as a preset character.
In rooms, the deployment of new VCI items is now temporarily paused while a location loads. VCI items will now appear after the location display effect is complete.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where special characters such as '<', '>', and '&' were not being correctly replaced when receiving comments containing multiple such characters.

notes.title: Virtualcast ver 2.6.7a released
notes.content:
[h2]Virtual Cast App[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added camera mask functionality.
This function allows you to control whether or not an object is visible to the camera in a room.
[list]
[*] See [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/room/ringmenu/camera/mask]here[/url] for more information.
[*] For the manual on VCI Documentation, see [url=https://developer.virtualcast.jp/vci-docs/manual/behavior/sub_item.html#id4]here[/url]
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Functional Improvements[/h3]
[list][/list]
[*] In a room, an icon is now displayed in the participant list if you are the administrator.
Also, when a participant in a room changes his/her administrative privileges, the change is now immediately reflected in the nameplate.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list][/list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented a participant who received a room invitation from a participant whose activity status was set to “Offline” from moving to that room.
[/list]
　
　
[h2]WEB[/h2]
[h3]Functional Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Web library has been updated.
Some of the behavior on the Web site may have changed from the previous version.
Please be aware of this.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs related to the update of the Web Library[/h3]
Due to the update of the web library, the following problems have been confirmed in the store page of the website.
[list]
[*] Embedding of X post is not displayed when setting embedding of X post on product detail page.
[/list]
This issue will be corrected at a later date.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
If you have any other problems, please report them to us through [url=https://virtualcast.jp/contact]Contact Us[/url]

　
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now you can get a player's profile picture from VCI.
[list]
[*] Manual on VCI Documentation is [url=https://developer.virtualcast.jp/vci-docs/api/classes/ExportRoomPlayer/GetProfileImageTextureId. html]here[/url]
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Functional Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjustments have been made to ensure that the performance of the operation does not decrease even if the same VCI synchronization variable is retrieved multiple times in a single frame.
This update was postponed from the previous release and implemented this time.
Bug fixes.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list][/list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the application to freeze in rare cases when continuously updating VCI synchronization variables.
Additional action has been taken since it was confirmed that the problem still occurred in some cases after the last release.
[/list]

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug that prevented a participant who received a room invitation from a participant whose activity status was set to “Offline” from moving to that room.

notes.title: [8/22更新] バーチャルキャスト ver 2.6.2a リリース
notes.content:
[h2]スタジオ[/h2]
[h3]ニコニコ連携復旧対応[/h3]
ニコニコサービス再開に伴い、バーチャルキャスト連携機能の復旧対応を行っております。
以下に現在の復旧状況を記載します。
[list]
[*]ニコニコ生放送のコメント連携およびVギフト連携ができます。
[/list]
以上で利用できなくなっていた連携機能は全て復旧しました。
[h3]仕様変更[/h3]
[list]
[*]スタジオのコメント連携機能に使用される一部フォントを視認性の良いものに変更しました。
[/list]
　
[h2]ルーム[/h2]
[h3]新機能[/h3]
[list]
[*]「VirtualCast公式わんコメOSCプラグイン」をリリースしました。
こちらを導入することで、ルームでもスタジオの配信コメント連携機能のような演出を実現できます。
    - [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/deliverytool/onecomme "導入方法"]導入方法[/url]
    - [url=https://developer.virtualcast.jp/vci-docs/manual/osc/onecomme_osc/index.html "プラグイン仕様ドキュメント"]プラグイン仕様ドキュメント[/url]
[/list]
[previewyoutube=v-CE6va1i9E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[h3]機能改善[/h3]
[list]
[*]ローディングスペースの描画の乱れを改善しました。
[/list]
[h3]仕様変更[/h3]
[list]
[*]VRM-1.0のモデルで、まばたきのOverride設定が反映されるようになりました。
[/list]
　
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]新機能[/h3]
[list]
[*]VCIスクリプトのExportVcSpaceTypeについて、命名規則を合わせたAPIを新設しました。
なお、旧来のAPIも引き続きご利用いただけます。
    - （既存API）　→　（新設API）
    - ExportVcSpaceType.room　→　ExportVcSpaceType.Room
    - ExportVcSpaceType.studio　→　ExportVcSpaceType.Studio

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.5.0a Video Player: Added an Error Message for Unsupported Video
notes.content:
[h2]Title[/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where unintended tag characters were input into the title configuration screen's text input field.
[/list]

[h2]Application[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Modified the directory where VirtualCast caches and user settings are stored.
    [list]
    [*] The changes are as follows:
        - Before: %UserProfile%\AppData\LocalLow\infiniteloop Co,Ltd\VirtualCast
        - After: %UserProfile%\AppData\LocalLow\VirtualCast\VirtualCast
    [*] If the new storage location does not exist, user configuration files will be copied from the old directory.
    [*] Temporary separation of settings between beta and stable versions.
    [/list]
[/list]

[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Web Video Player now displays a notice for Nico Nico videos that are not permitted for playback outside of a web browser.
[*] Reduced excessive information displayed when hovering over buttons in the item list of the ring menu.
[*] Enabled scrolling of text using the right controller's up and down buttons when viewing detailed item information in the ring menu.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the hand-shake correction for the stream camera for better usability.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where room details were not displayed correctly when viewed from the ring menu.
[/list]

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.4.2b Improved stability of connection to voice server
notes.content:
[h2]General[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reorganized graphic settings.
Due to this, graphic settings have been reset to "Recommended."
[/list]

[h2]Studio/Room[/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved stability of the connection with the audio server.
[/list]
[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted button generation process for the ring menu.
[/list]

[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]You will be returning to my studio or local studio when the host of the destination studio leaves.
[*]Changed to not cache video information in case of retrieval failure.
[/list]

[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a "delete all temporal items in the room" button under the Room Information menu.
[*]Implemented the ability to individually toggle the display of room's VCI console and FPS graph.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the synchronization of stream cameras and photo capture cameras operated by others in the room to be smoother.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed to display the VCI debug System Console near the location respawn point in the room.
[*]In the room, if you select a character from the Purchase History or Upload History without adding it to the inventory, you can now continue using that character even after restarting the application.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where zooming out the camera (scaling down by hands) too much would result in zooming in to the maximum.
[/list]


[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Specification Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed to display a console warning on the first execution if obsolete APIs are used.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added vci.vc.studio to the Lua code syntax for accessing ExportStudio.
[/list]
[h3]New APIs[/h3]
[list]
[*]Deprecated GetRight, GetUp, GetForward, and added the following APIs that return normalized values:
[list]
[*]GetNormalizedForward
[*]GetNormalizedRight
[*]GetNormalizedUp
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where noise occurs when playing Wave files with metadata in VCI.
[*]Fixed an issue where executing GetAudioSources with ExportTransform obtained by inputting a path into the GetTransform argument would not work correctly if there were other objects with the same name.
[/list]

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.3.9b Massive reinforcement on sound APIs for VCI
notes.content:
[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved stability of the studio video player
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the studio where the initial synchronization of shared variables for vci.state / vci.studio.shared does not work as expected when a player joins.
[*] Fixed an issue where comment cards in Showroom were not displayed correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where drawing on the whiteboard was not possible.
[*] Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented some gifts in Showroom from appearing.
[/list]
[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a button to update all items in a room that have been updated on the VirtualCast store.
[list][*] Only the room owner or managers can use the button.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] When a user is disconnected from the server due to a communication error in a room, the user will be automatically re-entered into the same room.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the room where if a player enters a room with the monitor camera locked, the snap rotation of the monitor camera will not work after it is unlocked.
[*] Disabled the ability to resize the application window using mouse drag.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Greatly enhanced audio functionality![/h3]
In this release, we have focused on expanding VCI's audio manipulation capabilities and have added multiple APIs. We hope that creators who make VCIs will make use of these new features.
Please refer to the individual API pages for more detailed usage instructions (Currently in Japanese only).

[h3]You can create a VCI like this![/h3]
[previewyoutube=bp0kRBEoMRg;full][/previewyoutube]

The VCI shown in the video is available on [url=https://virtualcast.jp/products/1106c03f53c8089257fbd8ca62ab6cb6557271fbd8ec863d32e6fbbb699932ce]the VirtualCast store[/url].

The source code is available on [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/sample/audio/playscheduled]the wiki[/url].

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exportanimation#settime]SetTime[/url] API to ExportAnimation.
[*] Added the following APIs to ExportAudioSource:
[list][*] [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exportaudiosource#settime]SetTime[/url]
[*] [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exportaudiosource#setpitch]SetPitch[/url]
[*] [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exportaudiosource#playscheduled]PlayScheduled[/url]
[*] [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exportaudiosource#getduration]GetDuration[/url]
[*] [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exportaudiosource#isplaying]IsPlaying[/url]
[*] [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exportaudiosource#getcurrenttime]GetCurrentTime[/url][/list]
[*] Added the [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exportme#getdsptime]GetDspTime[/url] API to ExportMe.
[*] You can now specify the following AudioSource parameters when creating a VCI in Unity. For details, see [url=https://wiki.virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/component/unity_audioclip#%E3%83%97%E3%83%AD%E3%83%91%E3%83%86%E3%82%A3%E3%83%BC%E3%81%AE%E8%AA%AC%E6%98%8E]here[/url].
[list][*] Pitch
[*] 3DSoundSettings
[list][*] minDistance
[*] maxDistance[/list][/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where Rigidbodies whose Interpolate is enabled didn't synchronize smoothly.
[/list]
[h2]Web[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The default protocol used when connecting to the room is changed to RUDP.
[/list]

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.3.4a Mesh colliders
notes.content:
[h2]Studios/Rooms[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where even if the "Voice chat audio quality" in Settings was set to over 50, the actual quality was ceiled to 50.
[list][*] This value is now 80 by default. For better voice quality, set this value to 100.
[*] If you experience frequent voice noise when setting a higher value, lowering the value to 50 or so may reduce the noise.[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the audio may become choppy in certain environments.
[list][*] If you still encounter similar symptoms after this patch, please contact us at [url=https://virtualcast.jp/contact/]here[/url].
[/list][/list]
[h2]Title[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] On the PC version, reduced memory usage in the title screen and rooms.
[/list]
[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed synchronization mechanism for the transformation of items in a room.
[list][*] We are trying to maintain compatibility, but if you find any behavior that differs from previous versions, we would appreciate it if you could report it to us.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the ring menu in Rooms; when selecting [Friends] > [Online] > (user name), the menu showing the room they are in, etc., was not displayed.
[/list]
[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where an item's Transform was not recovered as expected when reloading an item.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*]  The mesh collider is now available in VCI.
[list][*] Please check [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/component/unitycomponent/meshcollider]this[/url] page (Japanese) for instructions on how to use it, which will be updated as it becomes available.[/list]
[*] Added IsPlaying API to determine audio playback status.
[*] Added VCI's animation length and playback position acquisition API.
[*] Added VCI's audio playback length and playback position acquisition API.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Item will be reloaded with its Transform (Position, Rotation, Scale) preserved when the item placed in a room is refreshed using the Reload button.
[list][*] This Transform preservation feature is guaranteed to work on VCIs exported with UniVCI 0.39.1 and later.
[*] VCIs exported with earlier versions of UniVCI may be unable to restore their Transform.
[*] If that is the case, please remove the VCI manually and respawn.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where VCI's OnUngrab function was executed during VCI generation.
[/list]
[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the version of Effeckseer in the app to 1.7.
[/list]

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.3.2b VIVE Focus3 Eye/Facial Trackers Supported
notes.content:
[h2]Overall[/h2]
[h3]The System Update[/h3]
As announced earlier in the service development progress briefings, we made an update on the base system.
[list]
[*] Updated Unity to version 2022.
[*] Changed the rendering system from the Built-in Render Pipeline to the new Universal Render Pipeline.
[*] We introduced and explained these updates in detail in the service development progress briefings held on 22 June 2022 and 28 September 2022.
[list][*] For information on the new rendering system, refer to [url=https://virtualcast.jp/blog/2022/06/0622_shinchoku/]here[/url] (Japanese).
[*] For the update to Unity 2022, refer to [url=https://virtualcast.jp/blog/2022/09/0928_shinchoku/]here[/url][/list]
[*] If you find a bug that seems to be caused by the system update, please report from [url=https://virtualcast.jp/contact/]here[/url] (Japanese).
[/list]
[h2]Title[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some expressions and effects in the title scene.
[/list]
[h2]Studio/Room[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Meta information is now written to the photo file when a photo is taken.
[list][*] More detail on the meta information can be found [url=https://virtualcast.jp/blog/2022/12/1202_shinchoku/]here[/url] (Japanese article). [/list]
[*] Adjusted the stream camera's tally lamp bloom effect to be weaker, making it easier to see the monitor on the stream camera. 
[/list]
[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated VIVE eye tracking and face tracking libraries.
[list][*] This requires the latest version of SR Runtime.
[*] For the latest version of the SR Runtime update, please visit the [url=https://developer.vive.com/us/support/sdk/category_howto/where-to-download-eye-tracking-runtime-and-sdk.html] VIVE Developer page[/url].
[*] Also, please check [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/controller/viveproeye]here[/url] for information on using eye tracking and face tracking.[/list][/list]
[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the V gift generation process
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Videos taken with video capture are now saved with file names representing the date and time when the capture process ended.
[*] Pictures/videos taken with the Capture camera/Video capture are now saved in %userprofile%\Pictures\VirtualCast\Media\{YYYY-MM} folders.
[/list]
[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] The download progress will be shown while the room is loaded.
[/list]
[h3]Changes/Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] When you reload a VCI, the ring menu will now go back to the item list menu. This will solve the issue where different VCI might spawn in cases between when you create a new item and reload an existing one.
[*] Adjusted the design on the calibration scene.
[*] Optimized the memory management around the photo capture.
[*] Improved the stability of the server when using the RUDP.
[*] Changed how the sound volume of each VCI is handled: you can now change the volume of all instances of the same VCI at once.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where you couldn't touch other avatars' SpringBone.
[*] Fixed the issue where the column height setting reset to default when you select a "Next" button in the media history menu. 
[*] Fixed the issue where the scroll position resets when you select a "Next" button in the media history menu.
[*] Fixed the issue where returning the ring menu by pressing the menu button after opening the media history will cause a certain thumbnail to not display.
[*] Fixed the issue where some of the transform information is not saved when you leave a room right after you moved a subitem.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added ExportTransform.GetAttachedPlayer to VCI script, which will get the player id of the attached target of an attachable subitem.
[list][*] This API will return different user Ids in rooms and studios even if the user is the same.
[*] It also returns null when the ExportTransform is not Attachable or not attached.
[*] For details, see the [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/attachable#getattachedplayer] wiki reference[/url] (Japanese).
[/list][/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] For [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exporttransform#gettransform]ExportAssets.GetTransform[/url] in VCI, when you specify a name that starts with "/," the name will be considered as a path starting from the VCIObject. 
[list][*] For details, please see the [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exporttransform#gettransform]reference in the wiki[/url] (Japanese).
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the velocity was not appropriately applied when you used SetVelocity(Vector3.zero) on a character from VCI.
[/list]
[h2]Web[/h2]
[list]
[*] In the room settings, the property "The user who can change the location" is removed. From now on, the owner and the administrators will have the static location change permission.
[/list]

[list]

[list]

[*] Added a feature to reset the angle of the streaming camera by holding Use without grabbing it.

[*] In the VCI WebSocket logger, you can now scroll when items in the item list overflowed.
[/list]

[*] Fixed the issue where VCI crashed when the VCI script "requires" modules recursively/circularly.
[*] Fixed the issue where MatCaps on VCI is not rendered correctly.
[*] Fixed the issue where VCIs or characters with visually connected meshes that are actually separated data-wise are rendered unexpectedly.
[/list]

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.2.7a Straightened VRM & VCI download issue
notes.content:
[h2]Studio/Room[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted processes to combat the issue where the download of VRM and VCI stops.
[/list]
[h2]Rooms[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the timing of voice chat initiation. From "when your avatar is loaded" to "when you are moved to the room from the loading space."
[*] If a VCI placed in a room is already deleted on THE SEED ONLINE, it will be removed from the room when the room's owner or an administrator enters the room.
[*] Added a feature to change the volume for videos in the ring menu.
[*] You can change the volume from System > Sound > Video Volume.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an API that can acquire the name of controllers from VCIs.
[*] Following new APIs have been added.
[*] vci.me.GetLeftControllerName()
[*] vci.me.GetRightControllerName()
[*] If controllers don't exist (e.g., the battery ran out), these will return "none."
[*] When the controllers are switched, the result will change following the new controllers being connected.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the processing speed of the VCISpringBone.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where an error occurred when you tried to attach/detach an inactive attachable object from the VCI script.
[*] Fixed the issue where MatCap is not rendered correctly for VCIs.
[/list]
[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the platform Unity version to 2021.
[*] Location and item creators shouldn't have to do anything regarding this change, but if you find any issue, such as particular items not displaying correctly, please report from [url=https://virtualcast.jp/contact/]here[/url].
[/list]

notes.content:
[h2]Studio/Room[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Photos taken with the photo capture will be saved as {Room name}{Creator name}{Year-Month-Date}_{Serial number}.jpg in %USER%\Pictures\VirtualCast\Media{Year-Month}.
[*] Changed the behavior of the ring menu and the context menu when they are moved/rotated while being open.

[/list][/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the ring menu became unopenable after going through certain operations.

[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]

[list]
[*] Physics behavior has been adjusted so that it behaves the same no matter what type of HMD is being used.

[list][*] You can now hand over a photo you've taken by just creating a VCI for it and letting others acquire the VCI.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the lag of items that are being grabbed by hand.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where a user whose activity status is "offline" is shown on other users' friend lists.
[*] Fixed the issue where V-gift becomes enabled in rooms when streaming is started with a certain procedure.
[*] Fixed the issue where the capture process of a VCI which utilizes the camera API fails when the person who spawned the VCI is absent in the room.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now compare ExportForceMode from lua.
[*] Updated Effekseer from 1.5.2n to 1.6.2d.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the load time of VCIs using MP3 files.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the app crashed when it failed to load certain mp3 files in VCIs.
[/list]

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.2.1c Fixed the occasional crash while loading VRMs.
notes.content:
[h2]Room/Studio[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where, if you are using a Windows Mixed Reality HMD, looking at a specific angle caused your avatar to turn instantly in the opposite direction.
[*] Fixed the issue where the application occasionally crashed while loading VRMs.
[/list]
[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Linear" type has been added to the rotation type, which will gradually change the rotation speed depending on the angle of the controller input.
[previewyoutube=mu1Y_a1AEYY;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] Added a gauge to display photo capture and stream cameras' current zoom state.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now attract the camera monitor.
[*] Holding your hand over a global stream camera and local stream camera that are locked will now show the red highlight, which indicates that it is not attractable. 
[*] Changed the character physics in Rooms.
[list][*] Changed the mass of characters.[/list]
[*] In rooms, SpringBone will no longer be affected by the movement made by the joystick.
[list]
[*] Before
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/9c049ed9b376560a38461157402eee46e3f45bb3.gif[/img]
[*] After
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/231d900656a22a4d8a2f3fcadbd269dee647dd42.gif[/img]
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the first person offset is not applied to the characters when using a VRM with its value set.
[*] Fixed the issue where moving from a studio to a room while using a VRM with its first-person offset changed causes the graphic to distort.
[*] Fixed the issue where the preview display of the photo capture camera showed the area narrower than the actual photo to be taken.
[*] Fixed the issue where the failure of loading of a single VRM or VCI resulted in all other VRMs and VCIs failing to load.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added overloads to VciTransform.AddForce: vci.forceMode.Force and vci.forceMode.Impulse.
[list][*] Due to this, the traditional overload which receives one argument becomes obsolete.
[*] By using this API, you can suppress the difference in physical behavior derived from the FPS difference. 
[*] Also, to adapt to the change in execution order due to this change, the execution timing of VciTransform.SetVelocity and VciTransform.SetAngularVelocity has been adjusted.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where a Lua script stops running when a stack overflow occurs in the Lua script.
[*] Fixed the issue where you could transfer the ownership of the part of subitems that belongs to the same GroupID.
[/list]
[h2]Web[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now change the protocol to use when connecting to Rooms.
[list][*] You can change this setting from [url=https://room.virtualcast.jp/settings]here[/url]. You might be able to solve the problem of not being able to enter a room properly by changing this setting.
[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.2.0c Performance Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Room Studio[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The sale of Vgifts on nico live will be disabled when you move from the studio to room while live streaming to nico live.
[list][*] The sale of the Vgifts will be re-enabled when you go back to the studio from the above state.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where VirtualCast fails to launch if the app is installed under a path that contains double-byte characters.
[/list]
[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]  You will be shown an error message when you are using an unsupported avatar.
[/list]
[h2]Rooms[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the performance of the ring menu rendition.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the default control settings as below:
[list][*] Control Type: Action
[*] Analog Input: Enabled
[*] If you are already using VirtualCast, this won't change the control settings for you. However, the change will be applied when you initialize the save data or use VirtualCast for the first time.[/list]
[*] The running editions of the room are unified into the stable edition.
[list][*] If your room's running edition were set to beta, it would automatically be switched to the stable edition.
[*] The running edition setting on the website will be deleted.
[*] This change is preparation for the room support on Quest, which will enable the users to use the rooms easily. 
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the lock operation of VCI sometimes didn't work in a room with many VCIs in existence.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where vci.state.Add and vci.studio.shared.Add functions return error in the room environment. Due to this change, the atomicity of vci.state.Add and vci.studio.shared.Add functions under room environment have been removed; thus these functions are now deprecated.
[/list]
[h2]VRM[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where some meshes are not rendered for a certain model.
[/list]

[h2]Web[/h2]
[list]
[*] Text search, tag search and detail search features have been added to the room listing's search feature. Now, it's much easier to find rooms.
[*] You can now search friend with THE SEED ONLINE ID.
[*] In the My Rooms and Administrating Rooms, you can now distinguish the number of visitors by VR system types.
[/list]

[*] Fixed the issue where the lock operation of VCI sometimes didn't work in a room with many VCIs in existence.

[*] Fixed the issue where vci.state.Add and vci.studio.shared.Add functions return error in the room environment. Due to this change, the atomicity of vci.state.Add and vci.studio.shared.Add functions under room environment have been removed; thus these functions are now deprecated.
[*] Fixed the issue where some meshes are not rendered for a certain model.

[*] In the My Rooms and Administrating Rooms, you can now distinguish the number of visitors by VR system types.

[list][*] A single Global Stream Camera can exist in a room. The video taken with this streaming camera will be shared with all users.[/list]

[list]

[list][*] A Stream Camera that is active will have its tally lamps at the top of the camera and the finder and the rings at the bottom lit.
[*] The video rendered on the monitor camera and the desktop window is the video taken from the active Stream Camera.[/list]
[*] You can click shortly on the monitor camera to activate it.
[*] Holding the USE button while grabbing a Stream Camera will make it go into Parallel Movement mode. Releasing the USE button will disengage the mode.
[*] Choosing [Parallel Movement] in the context menu will keep the Stream Camera in the Parallel Movement mode. In this mode, the pitch (X-axis) and roll (Z-axis) of the Stream Camera will be fixed to 0.
[list][*] The selection of the Parallel Movement mode is not synced across users and is not saved to the room.[/list]
[*] You can zoom with the Stream Camera by grabbing it with both hands and pulling out and in.
[*] When there are more than one Stream Cameras in a room, the room will get a [On Air] badge on their icon in the list of rooms. For details, see the [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/room/streamcamera]wiki[/url](Japanese).

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.1.3d Camera API Release
notes.content:
[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Fixed the issue where the text input field in the settings > [Import] > [Persistent images to place in the studio (visible to cameras)] wobbles when multiple lines of text are typed in.[/list]
[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list][*] Changed the behavior of the ring menu: the ring menu won't close after each time you send a friend request.
[list][*] By this, you no longer have to re-open the ring menu each time you send a friend request, especially when you want to send multiple friend requests.[/list]
[*] You can now see yourself on the Room Information panel in the loading space when you enter a room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/ae655f719b20117e18a9b7ce1a515e99c83ca9ae.gif[/img]
[*] Paid assets will show "Purchase," free assets will show "Get" on the item context menu. You can now get free assets with fewer steps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/d7eeec49d8646854bdf2e3a27e50d0bcce33dcc4.gif[/img][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the issue where the character's mouth doesn't lip-sync under a certain condition.
[*] Fixed the issue where the height of the ring menu changes unintendedly when confirming calibration by pulling the triggers on both hands.
[*] Fixed the issue where spawning a VCI while there is a collider at the origin of the room will cause the VCI's physics to behave strangely.[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list][*]  The state variable (vci.state) for a VCI in Rooms will now be saved. 
[list][*] For detailed information on how to use the state variable, see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exportstate]here[/url].
[*] You will find a sample implementation in UniVCI v0.33.0,  [b]Assets/VCI-Official-Samples/StateApiSample[/b]. You may find it useful when you use the API.
[*] Added [url=https://seed.online/products/38dc60c7a6836d6b581ccd17de5ce78959acc7700c7da1a5fe5ba520cfaa5b12]StateApiSample[/url] on TSO, which will show you the change of the state variable in action.[/list]
[*] Camera API is added.
[list][*]  For details on how to use this, see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/script/reference/exportcamerasystem]here[/url].
[*] You will find a sample implementation in UniVCI v0.33.0,  [b]Assets/VCI-Official-Samples/CameraApiSample[/b]. You may find it useful when you use the API.
[*] We have added [url=https://seed.online/products/9c3b67770dc3523a193ed7829b9a3b77b00cef4f48153dc614fd8d25135a8f35]CameraApiSample[/url] on TSO, which will show the photography API in action.[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the issue where the specified volume setting is not applied for a very short moment right after a sound is played.
[*] Fixed the issue where some texts and effects persist in a room when a VCI is deleted while it is being loaded.
[*]  Fixed the issue where an unintended item is targeted when using [b]GetNameBoard[/b] and [b]HasNameBoard[/b] with "Name" specification.
[*] Fixed the issue where items become ungrabbable after their lock settings are unlocked.[/list]
[h2]WEB[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list][*] Owner and administrators can now edit room information from the room information page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/cf0a26b48f521cf341cabe778e14d34624ff66c6.png[/img]
[*] You can now change the "Room's status update" setting when creating a new room or editing an existing room.
[list][*] For detailed information on room's status update, see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/room/state_update]Room's status update[/url] (Japanese article).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/14fba1ad6e853f888f9e549b0d01ba0736ec7859.png[/img][/list][/list]

[h2]Common in both Studio/Room[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You must now [url=https://room.virtualcast.jp/corp_services]link[/url] with Twitter through the web.
[list][*] You can configure the Twitter integration feature from the [SNS Ingetration] in the settings screen.
[*] Click on [Connect] to open the integration page on the web.
[*] You need to be connected with THE SEED ONLINE to use the SNS integration feature.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/0f2a6868148f29ed6be0dc2346da129d09373905.png[/img]
[/list][/list]
[list]
[*] Optimized the rendering of characters and items.
[list][*] See [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/other/graphics_optimization]here[/url] for detials.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/dd40958709381571ce38ad8fb0ca3688d7c2130e.jpg[/img]
[/list][/list]
[list]
[*] The UniVRM library used for avatar loading has been updated to v0.84.0.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where a mesh set to FirstPersonOnly in VRMFirstPerson is being shown to third person.
[/list]
[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now hear the test sound when changing a volume for individual VCI from the context menu.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the laser is rendered on the ground when you spawned a laser pointer.
[*] Fixed the issue where blank space was shown when there is no item in the ring menu.
[/list]
[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an "analog input" option which will change your walk speed gradually depending on the tilt of the stick/pad.
[list][*] You can change this in the ring menu, [System] > [Control] > [Analog Input] > [Disable/Enable].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/9b48aa8e7ea649edb8e47eb0e955af2caf90456d.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the download and extraction process of VCI.
[*] Reduced the load time when entering a room.
[*] When a sync variable exceeds 16KiB and overflows, the debug console for the VCI will now show you that such error is occurring.
[*] Online friends playing different versions will no longer be listed on the online friend list.
[*] Walk animation will be disabled when you have trackers on both feet.
[*] Visibility of the friend notification HUD has been improved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/1436167f995949b219ea6ee09dfc8468d6fe74dd.png[/img]
[*] [Room Info] > [Tidy Up All] button has been added.
[list][*] This button will delete all items and link objects in the room that you have the delete permission for.
[*]  It is useful when you want to delete all items and link objects in the default tutorial room and create your room from the ground up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/f7d957322fc64cf9a176d37258d59795d86db5aa.png[/img][/list]
[*]  Temporary blackout has been added when transitioning between rooms, studios and the title.
[*] After entering the room, you can no longer go back to the studio while in the loading space.
[list][*] This is a temporary workaround to avoid an issue under a specific condition while in the loading space.[/list]
[*] Moved the [Accept Requests] and [Check Invitations] buttons to [Friends] in the ring menu. 
[*] Timeliness of the notification has been improved.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the room name and the number of users present in the room didn't appear on the link object.
[*] Fixed the issue where the object indicating loading error of a VCI is not being shown in the room.
[*] Fixed the issue where you couldn't delete the link objects with an invalid room key from the context menu.
[*] Fixed the issue where the VCI loading object is rendered black in a certain environment.
[*] Fixed the issue where the friend badge didn't fade out when maneuvering from the user details panel to the published room list.
[*] Fixed the issue where a friend request sometimes persists as an unapproved request even after the friend request has been approved.
[*] Fixed the issue where in the context menu of a VCI/camera, selecting "smooth turn" while the turn type is already set to "smooth" will result in the "snap turn" being selected.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where a vci.state set at the very beginning is not sent to the server.
[/list]
[h2]WEB[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Twitter has been added to the service integration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/f2e3bf3e74e863c5abd2139c343e974677e2eee5.png[/img]
[*] By integrating with Twitter, you can send a friend request to a friend who has also enabled the Twitter integration.
[list][*] You can make your account hidden from the friend search result, from the settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/77f1d2382239b5cbeba0b9218f0035edc2c139c7.png[/img]
[/list][/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The contents of the menu have been changed.
[/list]

[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the text input field in the settings > [Import] > [Persistent images to place in the studio (visible to cameras)] wobbles when multiple lines of text are typed in.

[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now see yourself on the Room Information panel in the loading space when you enter a room.

[*] Paid assets will show "Purchase," free assets will show "Get" on the item context menu. You can now get free assets with fewer steps.

[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the character's mouth doesn't lip-sync under a certain condition.
[*] Fixed the issue where the height of the ring menu changes unintendedly when confirming calibration by pulling the triggers on both hands.
[*] Fixed the issue where spawning a VCI while there is a collider at the origin of the room will cause the VCI's physics to behave strangely.
[/list]
[h2]WEB[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now change the "Room's status update" setting when creating a new room or editing an existing room.
[list][*] For detailed information on room's status update, see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/room/state_update]Room's status update[/url] (Japanese article).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/14fba1ad6e853f888f9e549b0d01ba0736ec7859.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.1.1c VCIs spawns closer
notes.content:
[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the order of buttons in some menus.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the list of the attractable items becomes corrupted when there are no attractable preset items.
[/list]
[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] We made it easier to remote grab VCIs that are out of your sight range.
[*] Adjusted the speed of purchase UI.
[*] Changed the spawn position of VCIs.
[*] Reduced the friction factor of the character's collider.
[*] Descriptions for My Statuses are now shown.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the voice chat doesn't reconnect properly in certain conditions when the voice chat is disconnected.
[*] Reduced unnecessary communications under specific conditions.
[*] Fixed the issue where the notification sound continues to ring every minute when there is a friend request.
[*] Fixed the issue where the Index controller sometimes didn't work properly.
[*] Fixed the issue where the "Items in the room" menu sometimes didn't show anything.
[*] Fixed the issue where you could only receive up to two invitations at once.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Room: Reverted the speed of sync variables (vci.state and vci.studio.shared) applying the result to the local environment when set to state before v2.0.7a.
[*] Fixed the issue where when more than one material with the same name exists, you couldn't access the material from Lua.
[/list]

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.1.0c Friend features now live on the stable version
notes.content:
[h2]Rooms[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the friend features.
[list][*] You can send friend requests to other users, and when they accept them, you will be their friend.
[*] You can send friend requests to participants in the same room or send from the owner information of the room and the user information of a VCI.
[*] When you become friends with a user, you can see where the friend is, jump to where the friend is, and invite the friend to your current room.

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.0.8b Calibration Persists Across Rooms
notes.content:
[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where pictures saved in png format did not appear correctly when a picture of a translucent object was taken.
[*] Fixed the issue where the size of some input fields in the settings screen kept changing under a certain condition.
[/list]
[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The calibration result now persists across Rooms.
[list][*] You no longer have to calibrate each time you move to different rooms.[/list]
[*] Publish state of the room will be shown on the room information panel.
[*] To improve the stability of the server, we have applied limitations to some synchronization APIs in VCI.
[list][*] This is a counteraction against some VCIs that could overload the entire sync server and shut it down in the former sync systems. 
[*] We will be adjusting this limitation as we go as we want everyone to play VirtualCast comfortably.
[/list]
[*] Here are the limitations in specific.
[list][*] APIs starting with _ALL_, such as _ALL_SetText, will have a sendable character limitation of 512 bytes (in UTF-8).
[list][*] This is about 500 alphabetical characters or about 250 Japanese characters.
[*] If you need to display a large number of texts, please use vci.state or vci.message API to synchronize.[/list]
[*] vci.message can send a text of up to 4000 bytes (in UTF-8).
[*] The amount of data you can share with vci.state is up to 16KB.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where you continued to move upward when changing locations under a certain condition.
[*] Fixed the issue where the title screen stutters frequently.
[*] Fixed the issue where items in My Studio might disappear by leaving a Room to go back to your Studio while you are still in the loading space.
[*] Fixed the issue where pictures saved in PNG format didn't render the image correctly when you took a picture of translucent objects.
[*] Fixed the issue where the hand colliders followed your hand with some delay when you are using Oculus controllers.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the emission value of VCI items that use standard shader turned into a non-HDR value. 
[*] Fixed the issue where the color of VCI items using unlit shader becomes lighter. 
[*] Fixed the issue where looking at a VCI from long-distance caused its texture to flicker.
[/list]

notes.content:
[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Errors that occurred in VCI scripts will be shown on the UI.
[*] You can now see the title of broadcasts when selecting on-air studios from the Studios list.
[*] Added a feature to return to My Studio by press-and-holding ESC key while in a studio on-air or an official studio.
[*] The video player now supports YouTube playlists.
[list][*] On the title, go to [b]Settings[/b] > [b]Import[/b] > [b]Video Playlist URLs[/b] and type in the URLs for YouTube playlists.
[*] The supported format of URL is [b]https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list={Playlist ID}[/b]. URLs in other formats may result in an error.
[*] In studios, open the context menu for the video player and select [b]Enter URL[/b] to see the playlist you entered in the Video Playlist URLs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/a0dc31cedae4da7ba81783269fd642024cc14acf.png[/img]
[/list][/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] When you are in an offline studio, the status of online/offline will no longer be displayed on the camera monitor.
[*] When connected with Twitter, an error message will be shown when retrieval of comment has failed due to hitting the concurrent connection limitation.
[*] Re-organized the order of selections in the ring menu.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where studio ID couldn't be copied in studios on air.
[/list]
[h2]Rooms[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Preset characters, items and locations have been added to the Room.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replaced the synchronization system.
[list][*] Some VCIs might behave differently. Please check them.[/list]
[*] Re-organized the order of selections in the ring menu.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where using the ring menu continuously would slow down the transition of the ring menu. 
[*] When you have selected JPEG in the [Settings] > [Camera] > [Export format for photo capture camera], the picture to be exported will now have the extension jpg instead of jpeg.
[*] Fixed the issue where the anti-aliasing setting for HMD was not being applied.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The behaviour of ExportAudioSource.PlayOneShot() was different from that of vci.assets.audio.PlayOneShot(). This isssue have been fiexed.
[list][*] Fixed the issue where calling ExportAudioSource.PlayOneShot() consecutively with different arguments for the volume value resulted in the volume of already playing audio changing while playing.[/list]
[*] Fixed the issue where grabbing the same SubItem with multiple users resulted in conflicting ownership assignments.
[*] Fixed the issue where grabbing SubItems with the same GroupId with multiple users resulted in conflicting ownership assignments.
[*] Fixed the issue where 3D audio was not working in VCI.
[*] Fixed the issue where ClipName API for AudioSource was not accessible.
[*] Fixed the issue where textures flickered when you see a VCI from far away.
[/list]

notes.title: MIKULAND β mini YOSAKURA
notes.content:
The theme of "MIKU LAND" is "somewhere near, in the near future".
You can experience an official Hatsune Miku amusement park in VR and AR.
Using VR/AR apps, you can visit MIKU LAND to experience the opening and ending ceremonies,
enjoy communicating with other users and purchase MIKU LAND original merchandise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/aed03d8029dadf319e0795b05a7e5316ce2b4c42.jpg[/img]

MIKU LAND is a Hatsune Miku themed amusement park in virtual reality which opens for a limited time in Virtual Cast, a live VR communication service operated by Virtual Cast, Inc. Following the winter themed edition held last February, the latest installment “mini YOSAKURA” will introduce MIKU LAND with a spring themed makeover filled with illuminated cherry blossom trees in full bloom. 

Amidst the breathtaking view, visitors can get together in groups for VR picnics and purchase exclusive VR items which include flyable VR drones, life-size Hatsune Miku digital figures and virtual cosplay outfits. Visitors also have the rare opportunity to meet up with virtual idols face-to-face and enjoy a one-of-a-kind experience. Immersive VR attractions (VR rhythm games and VR snowball fights) introduced in the previous edition will be made available again for all to enjoy.

[h2]Portable VR Rhythm Games■New Characters at Meet & Greet [/h2]
Virtual Idol Group GEMS COMPANY and Virtual Singer Sugar
In addition to Piapro characters such as Hatsune Miku, Kagamine Rin & Len and VTuber Shinonome Megu, members of the virtual idol group GEMS COMPANY produced by Square Enix will be making a special guest appearance inside MIKU LAND. Additionally, on May 1st, 13:00-14:00 JST, Virtual Singer Sugar will also be appearing to guide English speaking audiences. Visitors can meet up with their favorite idols in VR and enjoy chatting and taking photos.

【MIKU LAND β mini Yosakura- DETAILS】
■Dates : April 29th (Thurs.) 19:00 JST – May 1st (Sat.) 16:00 JST, 2021
■Venue : Main Venue > Virtual Cast (PC) 
Sub Venue > HoloModels (iOS/Android) 
■Admission Fee : Free
■Host : Virtual Cast, Inc., Gugenka Inc
■Cooperation : Crypton Future Media, INC. 
■World Architecture : Takeru Shoji Architects
■Official Website：https://mikuland.com/yosakura/   
■Twitter : https://twitter.com/Mikuland_info 

■Live-Streaming
【MIKU LAND DAY 1】April. 29th, 2021 19:00-23:00 JST (Opening Ceremony：19:00-19:30 JST) 
Niconico - https://live.nicovideo.jp/watch/lv331153309 
YouTube - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7M7m0ufZDYM 

【MIKU LAND DAY 2】April. 30th, 2021 19:00-23:00 JST
Niconico - https://live.nicovideo.jp/watch/lv331313742 
YouTube - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nWACAyKmxLY 

【MIKU LAND DAY 3】May. 1st, 2021 13:00-16:00 JST (Closing Ceremony：15:45-16:00 JST)
Niconico - https://live.nicovideo.jp/watch/lv331313787 
YouTube - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cSeiehOwl9o 

【VOCA COLLE VR NIGHT】May. 1st, 2021 19:00-21:00 JST
Niconico - https://live.nicovideo.jp/watch/lv331402518 

< What is “Hatsune Miku”?> 　Hatsune Miku is music software developed by Crypton Future Media, INC., which enables anyone to make their computer sing by entering lyrics and melodies. As a massive number of users created music using the software and posted their works on the Internet, Hatsune Miku quickly evolved into a cultural phenomenon. Moreover, Hatsune Miku has gained much attention as a character, involved in many fields such as merchandising and live performance as a virtual singer. Her popularity continues to spread across the globe. https://piapro.net ※Kagamine Rin, Kagamine Len, Megurine Luka, MEIKO and KAITO are also virtual singers developed by Crypton Future Media, INC.

< What is “GEMS COMPANY”?>
GEMS company is an idol group produced by Square Enix. The group consists of 12 girls who met through the internet and each member has their own unique personality and dreams. 
■Official Website : https://gemscompany.jp/ 

< Who is “Sugar”?>
Sugar is a singer-songwriter and video content creator who loves rock music. She also speaks both Japanese and English.
■Official YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/c/SUGAROCK_Ch
■Official Twitter : https://twitter.com/SUGAROCK_jp 

< Who is “Shinonome Megu”?>
Shinonome Megu is a girl living in Hiyorioka, Tokyo. She’s active as a songwriter, picture book author, leading actress for a VR musical and a VTuber with a goal to bring to happiness to everyone.
■Official YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/c/MeguRoom 
■Official Twitter : https://twitter.com/megu_shinonome 

<About HoloModels>
HoloModels is a cross-device digital figure app (AR/VR compatible) which enables users to decorate their spaces with
poseable anime AR figures made with 3DCG. Users can also attend exhibitions and events held in augmented reality from
their smartphones. HoloModels is operated by Gugenka Inc.

notes.title: [Stable] Ver 2.0.4g Video player supports YouTube
notes.content:
[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now see VCI debug consoles in Room
[list][*] Switchable in [System] > [For Developer] > [VCI Debug].[/list]
[*] If an item contains "Designed for PC," "Designed for VC Studio" or "Designed for VC Room" tags, you will be able to see those tags on the product information panel when purchasing an item in VR.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/9f00b5f7248941e6f6aa43e607a58103f3e8c305.png[/img]
[*] You can now use calibration within Room.
[list][*] To do so, select [Change Character] > [Calibration].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/42313a5b421ce266c7f776b1008036b595f8ece3.jpg[/img][/list]
[*] You can now change the audio input device within Room from the ring menu.
[list][*] You can do so from [System] > [Sound] > [Select Input Device].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/af891d9abdaebb37249ae973c1d740cefbcea45a.jpg[/img][/list]
[*] We have renewed the video player in Studio.
[list][*] You can now play videos from both Youtube and niconico.
[*] For detailed information see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/en/virtualcast/studio/item/videoplayer]here[/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/b784d9fcdd76c71f29652ce4de8f5c2fc350b822.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[*] Now supports VIVE Facial Tracker.[list]
[*] You can enable the facial tracker from the settings in the title screen, [Device] > [Enable VIVE Facial Tracker].
[*] It blends VRM's preset blend shapes: AIUEO. It doesn't support the extended blend shapes defined over the standard VRM.
[*] For details see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/en/virtualcast/controller/facial-tracker]the wiki entry[/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/fd6d8d0783c235699ae5697b5701d7675e748e09.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] You will be transported to "the loading space" while loading a location in Room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/c2dc9a08a2b61582373e0cd704ab5f13f7d54f45.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cache for Studio and Room will now be kept even after the application has quit.
[list][*] When the cache volume exceeds 5GB, the cache will be deleted from the oldest.
[*] You can delete all cache by selecting [General] > [Delete cache and reset][/list]
[*] You can now pass an item from one hand to another.
[*] Only the attractable VCIs will be listed in the "Attract" list from now on.
[list][*] VCIs without any attractable SubItem will not be shown on the list.[/list]
[*] Reduced the frame rate drops while drawing on the whiteboard.
[*] Added diagnostics ID and the ID copy button on the credits screen in the title.
[*] Removed the integration with niconi solid.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where blinking was not reflected correctly in Room when using a touchpad-type controller with the operation type "Room."
[*] Improved behavior when loading a large number of buttons simultaneously in a ring menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where audio playback was not working correctly when using VCIs with 3D audio enabled in Studio.
[*] Fixed an issue where photos taken with Photo Capture were not saved when the room name or user name contained characters that could not be used in the file name.
[*] Fixed an issue that made the ring menu inoperable when the character was buried in a collider.
[*] Fixed an issue where the location disappears when someone leaves an official studio.
[*] Fixed an issue in Studio where VCIs that are rigidbody and whose ownership is not yours stay pinned in mid-air when attracted.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Quick Start button in the VR title menu sometimes didn't work after a stream has ended.
[*] Fixed the issue where locked VCI items could be attached.
[*] Fixed the issue in Oculus Rift, Oculus Link or Cosmos environment; the emission point of hand laser was changed by whether the laser is hitting an item or not while striking the hand-gun pose or the count-one pose.
[*] Fixed an issue in Rooms where Constraints are being ignored when you grabbed a VCI with Rigidbody.Constraints specified.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the browser from opening the script logger for VCI
[*] Fixed an issue where attachable collider was not scaled when VCIAttachable Scale setting was enabled
[*] Fixed an issue where the ownership of a SubItem wasn't inherited to a user when the VCI SubItem is attached to the user.
[/list]
[h2]Website[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] User profile page has been added.
[list][*] The profile page shows the information set in the account management page in THE SEED ONLINE.
[*] The user profile page can be opened from the room owner name links in the user search and the room information pages or the room owner icon links.[/list]
[*] The user search feature has been added.
[/list]

notes.title: [Stable] VirtualCast ver 2.0.3e release
notes.content:
[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now take photos in the resolution of up to 4K
[list]
[*] From the settings, you can choose the resolution of capture camera: HD(1280×720), FHD(1920×1080), WQHD(2560×1440), 4KUHD(3840 x 2160)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/62127dc342c40e72c955978bffe41de7c2eec94c.jpg[/img][/list]
[*] You can now purchase characters, items and locations that are registered as unlisted products.
[list][*] The character, item or location can be purchased only when the user who spawned these are the product's registerer.
[/list]
[*] The title screen has been modified. You can now enter directly into your My Room or Studio/Room with an ID specified.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/4a954ecaed9c27bcc7de8b474534ee964c74143e.jpg[/img]
[*] Room: A feature to attract an item that is out of your reach is added.
[list][*] Aim and hold (0.5 seconds) your hand against an item that is in the range of 3m from you to emit a white line from your hand
[*] When the white line hits the item you want to attract, the item will start to light up (If the item is not attractable, the item will not light up)
[*] While in that state, press the grip button on the controller to attract the item toward you[/list]
[*] You can now specify the studio you want to visit beforehand from the Web page.
[list][*] You can visit the reserved studio by selecting [Studios] > [Specified Studio] > [Set on Web] from the ring-menu in Studio.
[*] You need to set the destination beforehand.
[*] For details see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/destination_reservation]https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/destination_reservation[/url]
[/list][/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the timing of when items and locations will appear after they have been loaded.
[*] Room: The head rotation offset will no longer be saved when changing characters.
[list][*] If you look up while your character is loading, your character will spawn in look-up posture
[*] To substitute, you can now specify the tilt offset of the head in the ring-menu (System > Motion adjustment)[/list]
[*] Room: You can now respawn the camera.
[*] You can now start a timer from the context menu of the camera.
[*] Studio: You can now reload the inventory from the ring-menu: System > Refresh Inventory.
[*] Studio: The VCI loading indicator will spawn in a lower position.
[*] Jump is now assigned to a button on the right-hand controller instead of the stick push.
[*] The expression control for the stick-type controller has been changed from `tilting joy-stick while pushing the stick down` to `tilting joy-stick while pushing the left-hand button.`
[*] The photos taken in Room will be named [{Date}_{Room name}_{Name of photographer}]
[*] Changed the order of preset items in Studio
[list][*] We have aggregated the usage rate of preset items and re-ordered them in the order from the most used to the least used.
[/list]
[*] When you take a selfie with the photo capture, you can now see the preview on top of the camera.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/8b0c6dee77b3c04f16509ef92c5cc48aaebf43f6.png[/img]
[*] Reduced the duration of location change animation in Room
[*] You can now specify your height in the calibration scene.
[*] You can now visit a room directly from the in-VR title menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/4249698d0e7b96744585df962cf5a8560df02fb8.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the walking motion was broken when you turned in a single point without walking.
[*] Fixed the issue where VirtualCast became unstable after long hours of continuous run.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]New feature[/h3]
[list]
[*] 3DAudio is now supported
[*] For detailed information see:
[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/updatelog/2.0.3b]https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/updatelog/2.0.3b[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: [Major Update][Stable]VirtualCast ver 2.0.1e release
notes.content:
[h3]※The method to connect with THE SEED ONLINE account has been changed[/h3]
The connection method has been changed to fortify security. From now on, you have to copy and paste the code.

Click on the [CONNECT] button at the upper right corner of the title screen to open the authentification code input dialog and the connection web page of THE SEED ONLINE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/c8f249d4110a6712dd7989858bf4be6a4dd10ca6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/6cbbfef0a8e2e48cea74578fa0eddf32a2407afb.png[/img]

Copy the code displayed on THE SEED ONLINE connection page, paste the code on the input field in VirtualCast and click [Next] to complete the steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/66f4729b3525347bb7adc2f79be4304a4f7cca70.png[/img]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Released the Room feature.
[list][*] Currently the user interface is available in Japanese only. English localization is coming soon.
[*]For details, see these articles(Japanese):
[list][*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/room]VirtualCast wiki About Room[/url]
[*] [url=https://virtualcast.jp/blog/2020/11/room_startguide_easy/]Room: Quick Guide[/url]
[*] [url=https://virtualcast.jp/blog/2020/11/room_startguide_stepup/]Room: Step-up Guide[/url]
[/list][/list]
[*] You can now specify the type of the controllers you are using in the settings screen(Only valid in the Room).
[list][*] The default is auto-detect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/cc4a3f8a375c17fea1a9b3878d14cb4910bcd601.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/47d144dc0c3e16d18e61501b4572f5fca9286c12.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Added HUD feature on the Room
[list][*] You can see your mic volume and current facial expression on the HUD when this feature is enabled
[*] For details, see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/room/ringmenu/system/hud][HUD Display][/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/b03faf46fe436c19acdf090119bbb528b25ceee3.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] You can now purchase VRMs from the character context menu in the Room.
[list][*] Point the hand laser toward a character to open the character context menu. You can purchase the VRM from the context menu.
[*] Note, if the VRM's license limits the use of the avatar to "the author only," you can not purchase it in VR.
[*] A VRM can be purchased if it is merchandised in The Seed Online.
[/list]
[*] Added block feature in the Room
[list][*] You can add a user to the block list from the Room page on the Web, the Participants list in the ring menu or the context menu opened by selecting a character.[/list]
[*] Added purchase history in the ring menu
[list][*] You can select items and characters purchased from within VR.[/list]
[*]  Added Photo Capture in the Room
[list][*] This feature allows you to take photos in the Room and post it to Twitter
[*] For details, see[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/room/camera%22] How to operate in-Room camera[/url](Currently in Japanese only)
[previewyoutube=Zck7LM5kRlE;full][/previewyoutube]
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] From now on, press and hold the menu button while touching an item to open a context menu.
[list][*] This change is made to avoid the context menu from popping up unintendedly by pressing the menu button while an attachable VCI is attached near your hands. This allows you to open the ring menu anytime by just pressing the menu button shortly.[/list]
[*] Unified the naming convention of images exported from whiteboard to that of images exported from capture camera. 
[*] Changed the display speed of button texts and ticker messages in the ring menu.
[*] Changed the controller binding for Grip and Use on Index controllers.
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][Before][/th]
        [th][After][/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Press the trigger to Grip[/td]
        [td]Squeeze the controller to Grip[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Press A to Use[/td]
        [td]Press the trigger to Use[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]	
[*] Made an internal improvement on the rotation speed and locomotion speed settings.
[*]You can now use VRMs "Authorized only to explicitly specified person" purchased in THE SEED ONLINE.
[list][*] Provided that the VRM is purchased on THE SEED ONLINE, you can use it as your avatar even when the VRM's license is set to "Authorized only to explicitly specified person."[/list]
[*] Fixed the error message that indicates the modification of lifespan is prohibited by the set privilege.
[list][*] When changing the lifespan of a VCI, you will be shown an error message if you do not have the privilege to execute that operation. The message has been reworded so that you can understand it more easily.[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the maximum length of the hand laser from 10m to 20m.
[*] Changed the laser shooting out of context menu to follow the object of interest.
[*] Optimized the ring menu to reduce the frame drop while manipulating it.
[*] When selecting a room on the ring menu, you can now see why you cannot enter a certain room (the room is full, you have no access right, etc.) before actually entering it.
[*] You will be notified when you couldn't enter the room because the room is full.
[*] The ReflectionProbe is now enabled in the Room
[list][*] This allows for rendering of accurate reflection on metallic materials in the Room[/list]
[*] You can now enable snapping of item rotation in the Room
[list][*] Snap toggle button is added in the context menu
[*] When the snap is enabled, the item will turn by 15 degrees while being grabbed[/list]
[*] Added a feature to load compressed textures when loading characters in the Room
[list][*] In the settings page, select [Graphics] > [Reduce memory usage for character rendering] to enable this feature
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/563d2b57f23afd4b3b98ebf49d4971c3ca5d0532.png[/img]
[*] This feature will compress the textures on character models to reduce memory consumption.
[*] Enabling this will reduce the memory usage, but it will lower the texture quality.[/list]
[*] You can now add a room to favorites from the context menu of a link object.
[*] Improved the download speed of THE SEED ONLINE items by compressing data.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where sometimes unintended button was displayed outside of the ring.
[*] Fixed the issue where sometimes the "VCI LOADING" object kept existing even after the VCI is deleted.
[*] Fixed the issue where an image on the queue card was not visible from a certain angle when the opacity of the queue card is set to 100%.
[*] Fixed the issue where you sometimes couldn't enter official studios properly (turns completely black).
[*] Fixed the issue where pressing the trigger lightly while in the finger paint mode disables the finger paint mode.
[*] Fixed the issue where the sound effect was not played when a VCI is deleted.
[*] Fixed the issue where the nameplate's voice indicator did not turn off when the mic mute is enabled while speaking.
[*] Fixed the issue where the FOV of a camera is not synced when entering a studio.
[*] Fixed the issue where grabbing a VCI item with gravity settings while the item is being attracted resulted in the item to be blown away.
[*] Fixed the issue where you couldn't load VCIs when you were running Windows in certain languages.
[*] Fixed the issue where you sometimes couldn't load VCI locations in the official studios.
[*] Fixed the issue where you couldn't change the multi-line while buttons are being loaded in the ring menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where a certain type of characters contained in a tweet caused an error.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
For details, see these articles
[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=vci:updatelog:2.0.0b]VirtualCast2.0.0b VCI Update[/url]
[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/updatelog/2.0.1a]VirtualCast2.0.1a VCI Update[/url]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now keep the show/hide setting of the VCI debug console between studios.
[list][*] Due to this change, your current setting will be reset to "disabled."
[*] Due to this change, the [VCI Debug] button in the ring menu > [System] will always be visible regardless of the setting in the title settings > [VCI] > [Display debug information in studio].
[/list]
[*] vci.assets.GetInstanceId() has been added with which you can acquire the unique ID of a VCI instance.
[*] You can now send and receive tables with VCI messages.
[*] vci.message.EmitWithId() has been added to allow you to specify the destination of the message.
[*] Adjusted the repulsion behavior of VCIs which has its IsKinematic value set to true
[*] You can now distinguish `Oculus Quest 2` with vci.me.GetHeadMountedDisplayName()
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated [url=https://effekseer.github.io/jp/]Effekseer[/url] to v1.52n.
[*] Added SetActive in VciTransform
[list][*] SetActive, ActiveSelf and ActiveInHierarchy is added in VCITransform.[/list]
[*] Added VCAST_materials_pbr extension
[list][*] Now, the Intensity value of HDR is applied on the EmissionColor of standard material.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where a json containing escaped slash cannot be parsed.
[*] Improved the loading speed of VRMs and VCIs in Room.
[/list]

[h2][/h2]
[list]
[*] From now on, press and hold the menu button while touching an item to open a context menu.

[*] Unified the naming convention of images exported from whiteboard to that of images exported from capture camera.

[table]
    [tr]

    [tr]
        [td]Press the trigger to Grip[/td]
        [td]Squeeze the controller to Grip[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Press A to Use[/td]
        [td]Press the trigger to Use[/td]
    [/tr]

[*] Fixed the issue where pressing the trigger lightly while in the finger paint mode disables the finger paint mode.
[*] Fixed the issue where the sound effect was not played when a VCI is deleted.
[*] Fixed the issue where the nameplate's voice indicator did not turn off when the mic mute is enabled while speaking.
[*] Fixed the issue where the FOV of a camera is not synced when entering a studio.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now keep the show/hide setting of the VCI debug console between studios.
[list][*] Due to this change, your current setting will be reset to "disabled."
[*] Due to this change, the [VCI Debug] button in the ring menu > [System] will always be visible regardless of the setting in the title settings > [VCI] > [Display debug information in studio].
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug-fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated [url=https://effekseer.github.io/jp/]Effekseer[/url] to v1.52n.

notes.content:
[h2]New features[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/058d8769e07ad219630ede1ca56b38e97aac9268.png[/img]

[*]  Now, when striking the hand-gun pose or count-one pose using VIVE Cosmos, the hand laser will be emitted from the index finger.

[*] The user height on the calibration screen will be hidden when you are not modifying the value.
[*] You can no longer open the ring menu while reloading VRM.

[*] Fixed the issue where VCI console couldn't be disabled.

[*] Fixed the issue where the stride length became short when you change your character from a short one to a tall one.
[*] Fixed the issue where preset items were sometimes spawned in small sizes when you enter a studio.
[*] Fixed the issue where an object behind the VCI purchase menu was sometimes rendered in front of the menu.
[*] Fixed the issue where the head of an avatar did not follow the position of the HMD bellow certain height when Vive Trackers are used for feet only.
