notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/0a4ddbd4136f304e27ec60f71e36d3c142ea4e02.png[/img]

[h2]New features[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/45907e59e52138749963c5c0ca9ef43b67a26a87.png[/img]
[list][*] Added Graphics tab in the Settings in which you can specify detailed settings related to graphics.
[list][*] You can find detailed information on the wiki
[list][*] [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:virtualcast:setting:graphics:basic]Graphics Basic Settings[/url]
[*] [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:virtualcast:setting:graphics:quality]Graphics Quality Settings[/url][/list][/list][/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the background of ring menu and context menu to be opaque to reduce load.
[*] Shrank the size of the ring menu and the context menu.
[*] Direct view joiners can no longer talk.
[*] You can now choose from the ring-menu whether or not characters bob up-and-down while walking.
[*] You can no longer join official studios with direct-view mode.
[*] Changed the hierarchy of [User Height] in the ring-menu.
[list][*] Moved from [System] > [Motion filter] > [Parameter Settings] > [User Height] to [System] > [User Height][/list]
[*] Added the same spawn/delete sound effects as preset items to when a custom item is spawned or deleted.
[*] You can no longer attract preset items that are spawned by players other than yourself.
[*] A studio owner can now lock or unlock the position of VCI items spawned by players other than the owner themself.
[*] The [Yes] button is now on the right side of THE SEED ONLINE integration dialog.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list][*] Now, you can attract items and custom items toward you by using ring-menu.
[list][*] [Item] > [Attract]
[*] [Custom Item] > [Attract][/list]
[*] Now, your height will be estimated and saved on the first calibration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/275595ac4b131278a0c8f7113e21432b17f66eff.png[/img]
[*] The calibration is now done based on the user height setting when changing an avatar. For this reason, [b]please make sure to set your height[/b].
[list][*] If you want your avatar to stand while you are seated in reality, you have to change your height setting.
[*] This feature is planned to be improved in future updates.
[*] For details, see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:virtualcast:operation:heightmeasurement]this wiki[/url] page.
[/list]
[*] Reduced the computational load of the movie capture item when it is not recording.
[*] Changed the behavior of the context menu to follow the movement of the player to improve usability.
[list][*] Added a line to indicate which item the context menu is opened for.[/list]
[previewyoutube=v_BlNU3GvS4;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] Optimized the memory usage of VRM models and VCI items.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where locations and items placed permanently on official studios didn't load properly in certain cases.
[*] Fixed the issue where the maximum number of direct-viewers was not distinguished from the number of usual performers.
[*] Fixed the issue where the rich-text format was usable on the rooms list.
[*] Fixed the issue where user icons for SHOWROOM users were not acquired properly.
[*] Fixed the issue where your change in the visibility of items whose ownership you don't have was not in sync with other players.
[*] Fixed the issue where nicolive cruise comments were not spawning properly.
[*] Fixed the issue where the movie capture item was not working properly in the environment where the name of the Windows user account contains multi-byte characters.
[*] Fixed the issue where button names in the attract list for custom items were incorrect.
[*] Updated the SteamVR controller bind setting for Cosmos controller
[list][*] You can now walk and change facial expressions by just tilting the joysticks.
[*] You can now use the items by pressing the grip button.[/list]
[*] Fixed the issue where FastSpringBone was not working properly in some models.
[*] Fixed the issue where models were not loadable when FastSpringBone is disabled.
[*] Fixed minor issues.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
The version of VCI is now v0.29.
For changes in the new VCI version, refer to the following pages:
[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:updatelog:1.9.3c]Changes in VCI v0.28[/url]
[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:updatelog:1.9.3e]Changes in VCI v0.29[/url]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:sdk:playerspawnpoint:introduction]specify spawn points for players[/url] in VCI locations.
[*] The join and leave notification of direct viewers is now acquirable from VCI.
[*] Added the scale and position settings for attachable VCI.
[list][*] For details, see this [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:sdk:attachable:introduction]wiki[/url] page.[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list][*] Enlarged the FPS display on the debug console and shortened the refresh interval.[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where arguments of types.lua were not exported correctly.
[*] Fixed the issue where moving a grabbable VCIPlayerSpawnPoint on y-coordinate direction resulted in users joining the studio from then on to spawn on the moved y-coordinate.
[*] Fixed the issue where VCI items with its RigidBody's [Constraints Freeze Position] set could be pulled using hand laser.
[*] Fixed the issue where some mp3 data couldn't be played.
[*] Fixed the issue where the function vci.assets.HapticPulseOnTouchingController was not working properly in VCI.
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/0a4ddbd4136f304e27ec60f71e36d3c142ea4e02.png[/img]
[quote]On this version, a change has been made to the contents of permission. Therefore, you [b]must re-connect with THE SEED ONLINE[/b] even if you have already connected it in earlier versions.
[u]The connection made on earlier versions will be disabled as soon as you launch this version of VirtualCast[/u][/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/64488f9a4729e9841f247ec69e097a24f8101c41.png[/img]
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list][*] As you are now able to commercialize assets posted on THE SEED ONLINE, you can see the product information of VCI items.
[list][*] You can check the VCI item information from [Product Information] in the context menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/48eaa83b2f531d152af1368197b98e524fdb2839.png[/img]

[*] The conditions under which you can see the product information are as follows.
[list][*] Connected with THE SEED ONLINE
[*] The VCI item is registered as a product.
[*] The VCI item is set to [Public (公開)] (You cannot see the product information of items in [Unlisted (限定公開)] state).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/a9769508daf2ae9fe00b46b69a3aad0dd0a97229.png[/img][/list][/list]
[*] Renovated the tutorial background
[previewyoutube=te45qeHNngE;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] Added a feature to disable the desktop rendering.
[list][*] While in a studio, press the X key on the keyboard to disable the rendering.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/a1413b7662aa3d5a73407b2f914db337471ad4d2.png[/img][/list]
[*] You can now move and change facial expressions using the joystick on Windows MR controllers.
[list][*]  If joysticks don't work, make sure that the default controller bind is selected in SteamVR settings. The name of the default bind is "Official Bind Configuration for Windows MR."
[*] Due to this change, the default controller bind for the Valve Index controller has also been changed. Please use the bind called "Official bind for Valve Index Controller". (In this bind, the "Position" of the "Thumb Stick" is assigned to "joystickposition". Nothing else is changed.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/cfa90872c70e5e5044627051dff6e473dc793cb0.png[/img][/list]
[*] Added an option to use TCP connection for the communication, which can be found on the title screen > [Settings] > [System]. 
[list][*] Try this option only when the connection to studios is unstable as this option raises the communicational load.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/c1d8495ab21be02a1e0b6e1a7da088042207d61d.png[/img][/list][/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list][*] Adjusted the behavior of the vignette
[*] Modified the inventory list screen for THE SEED ONLINE to match with the changes made on THE SEED ONLINE with its β release.
[*] You will now return to My Studio when you are kicked out from a joined studio.
[*] When a falling DVD reaches a certain height, the physics for the DVD will be disabled.
[*] Official studios are now shown on the left side of the join list.
[*] Added license screen on the title.[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list][*] Reduced the occurrence of broken official studios.
[*] Added a warning message for "Reset and quit."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/e38bba3447e6a5323f7dc2467b22e70b6dd93fa4.png[/img]
[/list]

[list][*] Added VRM load progress display on the title.
[*] Reduced the slowdown of the terms of use screen and the settings screen.
[*] Changed the design of the talk-back indicator on the title for clarity.
[*] Now the backside of the cue card will be rendered when the opacity of the cue card is lowered.[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed the issue where agreeing with the terms of use inside the VR did not move the desktop screen forward. 
[*] Fixed the issue where multi-assignable items in the title configuration, such as "URLs for whiteboard images," were not able to accept multiple entries by copy & paste.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/a665c3cf6495f17413b2ecaee7147c669297f124.png[/img][/list]
[list][*]Fixed the issue where in the title screen, the cursor protruded from some textboxes.
[*] Fixed the issue where in the settings, [General] > [Input device] was not saved.
[*] Fixed the issue where the logo on the camera monitor is rendered on cameras such as the handy camera.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the connection to the studio to be broken when the SteamVR dashboard was left open while playing.
[*] Fixed various minor issues.[/list]
[h1]VCI[/h1]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list][*] Added a function to run a coroutine. [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:script:reference:exportvci#start_a_coroutine]Here is the wiki page[/url].
[*] Added a function to reset the position of VCI.[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:script:reference:exportvci#reset_the_transform_of_vci]Here is the wiki page[/url].
[*] Added functions to get information on HMD and the language setting.[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:script:reference:exportme#get_the_information_on_hmd_and_language]Here is the wiki page[/url].
[*] Added functions related to attachable items.[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:script:reference:exporttransform#controlling_an_attachable_item]Here is the wiki page[/url].
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

[/list]

notes.title: Ver 1.8.3a release
notes.content:
[h2]New features[/h2]
[list][*] Added in-VR error notification window
[*] You can now open the item's menu (context menu) from a distance and manipulate it.
[list][*] Press and holding the menu button will allow you to select an item from a distance. Point to an item you want to select and release the menu button to open the context menu.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list][*] Changed the guidance image in the tutorial studio.
[*] You can now change the walking speed gradually with analog input.
[list][*] In the ring menu, turn on [System] > [Locomotion] > [Speed Settings] > [Variable Speed] to enable this feature.[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where SHOWROOM gifting items stopped falling in a certain environment
[*] Fixed the issue where the voice chat becomes noisy in a certain environment.
[*] Improved the stability of the voice server
[list][*] You will be automatically reconnected to the voice server whenever you are disconnected from it. When someone reconnects to the voice server, their individual volume setting will reset to default, which we are planning to correct in the future.[/list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the mosaic reflected on the mirror is not shown correctly
[*] Fixed the issue where application stops while you are opening the SteamVR Dashboard
[*] Fixed the issue where some of the items kept sticking in hands. 
[*] Fixed the issue where in some cases, you were sent to black void after calibration.
[*] Fixed the issue where falling items sometimes disappeared even when they are pinned on the air
[*] Fixed the issue where title screen hangs after clicking on the thumbnail
[*] Fixed the issue where SnapTurn and Teleport did not work as intended when using SteamVR Controller Binding
[*] Fixed the issue where emoticons are shown transparent in some backgrounds.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now choose whether or not to transfer comments to VCI from the ring menu.
[*] Added a feature to acquire avatar information
[*] Added a feature to manipulate name board 
[*] Added a feature to import mp3 into VCI
[*] Added functions to acquire bone information from avatars
[list][*] See the wiki for detailed information
[*] [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:updatelog:1.8.3a]https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:updatelog:1.8.3a[/url]

※The motion filter is an experimental feature. It will continue to be improved.

notes.title: VirtualCast Product Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/3036ba785a6206754cdd28c5198bb2d41e838876.png[/img]
[h1]【VirtualCast】[/h1]
[h1]October 2019[/h1]
[b]■Improved voice chat[/b]
Greatly reduces the jumpiness of the voice chat.

[b]■Improved full-body tracking precision[/b]
Improves the precision of the motion capture when multiple trackers are used.

[b]■Video capture feature[/b]
If you have a video capture device connected to your PC, you can see the video within VR.

[b]■Quickly start VirtualCast from within HMD[/b]
You can start VirtualCast without complicated settings on the desktop screen. Just select Quick Start within VR and you are ready.

[h1]November 2019[/h1]
[b]■Addition of SHOWROOM gifts[/b]
You will be able to receive gifts thrown in SHOWROOM in VR as well.

[b]■Limited time niconico live Vgift "School Fest(tentative)"[/b]
November exclusive Vgifts.

[h1]December 2019[/h1]
[b]■Major update "VirtualCast 2.0"[/b]
Addition of the following features and renewal of logo and design.

[b]■My Room feature[/b]
Each user can have their own room.
My Room can be publicized so that users can open a long term exhibition and events.

[b]■Improved UI[/b]
The Ring UI will be re-arranged based on current usage stats to improve usability. 
Title UI will also be re-adjusted so you can start VirtualCast more smoothly.

[b]■Increased concurrent connection in a single room[/b]
Use polygon reduction feature of THE SEED ONLINE to lessen the graphical load when many users are connected in a single room.

[b]■VR Time-shift feature[/b]
You can record the events happening in the VR space.
The recordings can be overlayed, providing a new way of enjoying VR.

[h1]Winter ~ Spring 2020[/h1]
[b]■Standalone HMD support[/b]
You will be able to play VirtualCast on VR devices that don't require a PC

[b]■Spectate feature for PC[/b]
You will be able to spectate VirtualCast without using VR devices.

[b]■Access THE SEED ONLINE from within the app[/b]
You will be able to access THE SEED ONLINE from within VR without using a Web browser and import or purchase items and avatars posted on THE SEED ONLINE directly.

[h1]【THE SEED ONLINE】[/h1]
[h1]October 2019[/h1]
[b]■VRM polygon reduction feature[/b]
The number of polygons can be reduced depending on where the model is being exported.
This feature enables performance optimization based on the target platform, allowing for a larger number of attendees in a single VR space, optimization for smartphone apps, etc. Making THE SEED ONLINE integration much easier.

[b]■VRM data encryption[/b]
Apply an encryption process to prevent unauthorized editing of models. Providing a safe environment for utilizing models in various applications.

[h1]December 2019[/h1]
[b]■SDK2 release[/b]
We will be releasing a new version of SDK incorporating the new features added in the October update, making implementation into application easier.

[b]■Friend feature[/b]
You will be able to communicate and share among friends more easily.

[h1]Winter ~ Spring 2020[/h1]
[b]■Improved search[/b]
Finding what you want from loads of posted items becomes easier.

[b]■Improved inventory organization system[/b]
Organize imported items more easily.

[b]■In service currency[/b]
Introducing in service currency which can be used for trading items.

[b]■User store feature[/b]
You can open up your own store and publish the items you created.

Read the article on PANORA for an in-depth interview with our officers explaining the future of VirtualCast (Japanese article).

https://panora.tokyo/archives/653

notes.title: Ver 1.7.2a release
notes.content:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added autumn gifts
[*] Added brown color on marker pen
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34269075/c7107b742d69e84ce98513a7e9e25eacf1ee8ea0.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now change the visibility of the mirror item
[*] Lines on the whiteboard is even smoother
[*] Now you can change settings without restarting the software (With some exception)
[*] Changed the speed of FOV operation on cameras
[*] Minor change to the behavior of teleport and step locomotions
[*] Walking animation will be disabled in certain postures when Vive trackers are in use
[*] Now supports SteamVR Plugin 2.0
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem where the name of the comment submitter won't display properly on SHOWROOM comment cards
[*] Fixed the problem where the layout of the comment cards gets corrupted in some situation
[*] Fixed the problem where the scroll in the settings screen stops in a certain situation
[*] Fixed the problem where unwanted UI image is captured together when saving the whiteboard in a certain situation
[*] Fixed the problem where the position unintendedly shifts when changing character models in some situation
[*] Fixed the problem where controller haptic is not working when using Oculus Rift or Oculus Rift S
[*] Fixed the problem where finger pose with the flick is registered even while the user is moving or changing their facial expression
[/list]

[h1]VCI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now you can perform operations on preset items (e.g., Handy camera) in a studio using VCI
[*] VCI now supports multiple animations
[*] Size changes on effects are now effective
[/list]
See the wiki for more information
[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:updatelog:1.7.2a]https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:updatelog:1.7.2a[/url]

notes.title: Ver 1.7.1a release
notes.content:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Chroma key studio
[list]
[*] Chroma key studio is newly added in preset backgrounds
[*] You can change the color of chroma key studio in the settings screen
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34269075/d160080172202ac9a18aaad2fd05e4f0850f413a.png[/img]
[*] Now you can set multiple comments for Twitter submissions
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34269075/9638312139cfe5f6e0be27864b59c6dd08768529.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjusted overall motion for avatars with Vive Trackers (Especially around the knees)
[*] Disabled niconare integration feature
[*] Login session for niconico account is now retained
[list]
[*] If you have a login session retained during the app launch, the login screen is skipped in the niconico tab. You will be directly presented with the stream configuration screen.
[*] The login session is kept alive until you explicitly log out of it
[/list]
[*] You can now change the FastSpringBone usage without restarting
[*] Fixed the abnormal movement on VRM models with incorrect Hip bone positioning. 
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem where the motion of characters could become unnatural
[*] Fixed the problem where the synchronization for the position of the characters might drift.
[*] Fixed the problem where the model change effect might play twice.
[*] Fixed the problem where an item might stick to your hand when locking it.
[*] Fixed the problem where the laser pointer might become unusable
[*] Fixed the problem where the color of meters on multiple video captures unintendedly synchronize.
[/list]
[h1]VCI[/h1]
[list]
[*] VCI reload feature is now available
[list]
[*] This feature allows you to reload the VCI uploaded to THE SEED ONLINE instantly.
[*] Select [Reload] in the context menu for the VCI of your interest
[/list]
[*] You can now change the loudness for each VCI individually
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34269075/ab53d80fe4a33a028d2009561270356fbb41b21f.png[/img]

notes.title: Ver 1.7.0a release
notes.content:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now available on Steam
[*]Implemented an item "Mirror"
[*]Added Summer (festival) V-gifts
[*]All the settings available through config.json is now configurable on Settings UI
[*]Added six pre-installed avatars
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed the location of config.json to [My Documents/My Games/VirtualCast/config.json]
[*]Changed the background transition effect
[*]Studio ID is now generated even on [Do not broadcast] tab
[*]Walk animation is added for the character locomotion
[*]Visibility of the name tags are now changeable
[*]The name tags are now lockable
[*]Removed the Random Join feature
[*]The item [Video Capture] now stays alive after finishing a shot
[*]The save destination of movies and photos now changed to My Pictures
[*]The item [Mirror screen] is now renamed as [Camera monitor]
[/list]

[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem where the visibility state of items are not synced to a player who joined the studio after the visibility is changed.
[*]Removed the VR Dashboard disable feature, as it was no longer working
[*]Fixed a problem where, in the SEED integration screen, the number of imported items is sometimes shown as 31
[/list]

[h1]VCI updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]UniVCI is updated
[/list]
[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:vci:updatelog:1.7.0a]VCI update on Virtual Cast 1.7.0a[/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34269075/54fabdaba5b9a4ee00f6d0436ebff22f5ada05fc.png[/img]
